metaDescription: Order custom medium lanyards for events, ID badges, and giveaways. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Medium lanyards offer a balanced width that provides durability without being bulky, making them a practical choice for daily badge wear or event credentials. Whether you need 3/4" woven styles for a polished corporate look or antimicrobial options for healthcare environments, medium lanyards accommodate standard badge clips and card holders comfortably. They are also ideal for imprinting logos with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation, ensuring your branding stands out at trade shows or in the office.
heroAltText: Assorted custom medium lanyards with printed logos and various attachment options for badges
